summary: This sermon explores Ephesians 4:1-13, emphasizing that believers are not merely given gifts but are themselves God's gifts to the world. Kent McKay traces how God took the Levites as captives and gave them back to Israel so He could dwell among them, then parallels this with how Christ sanctifies believers and sends them back as gifts to make disciples in unity.
key_points: Unity is central: one body, one Spirit, one calling to discipleship
Believers are the gifts God gives back to the world, not just recipients of gifts
Walk worthy of your calling with humility, gentleness, and patience
Different giftings (apostles, prophets, pastors, teachers) must work together in unity
The mission: called out as disciples, gifted back to make more disciples together
big_idea: Believers are called out as disciples and gifted back to the world to make more disciples together in unity.
title: A Gifted Church
